description: Implementation of UberLossAlgorithm class for QUIC congestion control, including loss detection, tuning, and reordering management.

classes.name: UberLossAlgorithm
classes.description: Class implementing loss detection and congestion control logic for QUIC, including loss timeout calculation, loss detection, and tuning management.

methods.name: UberLossAlgorithm
methods.description: Constructor initializing loss algorithms for each packet number space.

methods.name: SetFromConfig
methods.description: Configures the loss algorithm based on QUIC configuration and perspective.

methods.name: DetectLosses
methods.description: Detects packet losses based on unacked packets, RTT, and other metrics.

methods.name: GetLossTimeout
methods.description: Returns the earliest loss timeout among all packet spaces.

methods.name: SpuriousLossDetected
methods.description: Handles detection of spurious losses.

methods.name: SetLossDetectionTuner
methods.description: Sets the tuner for adaptive loss detection parameters.

methods.name: MaybeStartTuning
methods.description: Initiates tuning if conditions are met.

methods.name: OnConfigNegotiated
methods.description: Placeholder for actions after configuration negotiation.

methods.name: OnMinRttAvailable
methods.description: Triggers tuning when minimum RTT becomes available.

methods.name: OnUserAgentIdKnown
methods.description: Triggers tuning when user agent ID is known.

methods.name: OnConnectionClosed
methods.description: Finalizes tuning upon connection closure.

methods.name: OnReorderingDetected
methods.description: Handles reordering detection and possibly starts tuning.

methods.name: SetReorderingShift
methods.description: Sets reordering shift value for all packet spaces.

methods.name: SetReorderingThreshold
methods.description: Sets reordering threshold for all packet spaces.

methods.name: EnableAdaptiveReorderingThreshold
methods.description: Enables adaptive reordering threshold for all packet spaces.

methods.name: DisableAdaptiveReorderingThreshold
methods.description: Disables adaptive reordering threshold for all packet spaces.

methods.name: EnableAdaptiveTimeThreshold
methods.description: Enables adaptive time threshold for all packet spaces.

methods.name: GetPacketReorderingThreshold
methods.description: Returns reordering threshold for application data space.

methods.name: GetPacketReorderingShift
methods.description: Returns reordering shift for application data space.

methods.name: DisablePacketThresholdForRuntPackets
methods.description: Disables packet threshold for runt packets in all spaces.

methods.name: ResetLossDetection
methods.description: Resets loss detection state for a specific packet number space.
